overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures and exports dehydrated Giloy Powder derived from carefully selected Tinospora cordifolia stems. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter based in India, we follow a disciplined six-step production process. Raw materials undergo rigorous sorting, cleaning, controlled drying, and precise milling. The resulting fine powder provides consistent physical characteristics and reliable quality for global bulk ingredient buyers.

Our Giloy Powder features an 80 to 100 mesh size with moisture controlled below eight percent. We support commercial brands with OEM services, private labeling, and bulk supply solutions. Buyers receive complete export documentation support, flexible packaging options, and prompt sample dispatch. Every batch is packaged to ensure stability throughout its twenty-four month shelf life during transit and storage.
highlights: Processed from selected Tinospora cordifolia stems
Dehydrated with controlled moisture at or below 8%
Fine particle size calibrated to 80-100 mesh
Stable shelf life of 24 months in proper storage
Custom mesh sizing and packaging available on request
Minimum order quantity starting from 5 Kg

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Giloy Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating emerging businesses as well as large-scale industrial buyers.

faqs.q: What are the standard specifications of your Giloy Powder?
faqs.a: The powder features an 80 to 100 mesh size, a moisture level of 8% or less, and a shelf life of 24 months.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom particle sizing or private labeling?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer OEM, private label packaging, and custom mesh sizing tailored to your specific manufacturing requirements.

faqs.q: What packaging configurations are available for commercial orders?
faqs.a: We provide bulk 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small private-label retail pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Are product samples available prior to placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request to assist with your formulation testing and specification verification.

faqs.q: What export and documentation support do you offer?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter and FSSAI-licensed manufacturer, we provide complete export documentation support and batch traceability for shipments.
